review_text: Beautiful villa and Suresh was incredibly helpful - arranged a cook at short notice and gave great beach tips. Only issue was the pool looked green and wasn't cleaned during our 3-night stay.
Lovely property but the swimming pool was not maintained - murky water the whole time. Caretaker was polite and responsive though.
Pool was dirty and clearly hadn't been cleaned in days. Disappointing for the price. The caretaker himself was nice and tried to help.
Perfect stay! Suresh went above and beyond. Spotless interiors, great location in Assagao.
Excellent host service. Suresh arranged airport pickup and a birthday cake. Highly recommend.
Listing photos show a clear valley view but ours was blocked by an under-construction building next door. Felt misled. Mahesh was apologetic but couldn't do anything.
WiFi did not work the entire weekend and we were there to work remotely. Raised it multiple times, no fix.
Decent place for a group. WiFi was patchy. Caretaker Mahesh helped with everything else.
Good for a family weekend. The master AC stopped working on day 2 but Mahesh got a technician the same day.
Great villa, great host. Mahesh is a gem.
Stunning coffee-estate views. But check-in was a mess - caretaker arrived 90 minutes late and we waited outside in the rain.
Nobody was there to receive us at the scheduled time. Had to call the manager. The property itself is gorgeous.
Beautiful location. Hot water in the second bathroom didn't work.
Magical place, woke up to mist over the hills. Loved it.
Great estate stay. Geyser in one bathroom was faulty.
Check-in was delayed by over an hour and the caretaker was unreachable on phone. Once he arrived it was fine but a frustrating start.
Lovely property surrounded by greenery. Setup took a while on arrival.
Peaceful and clean. Would visit again.
Nice villa but the road leading up is in terrible condition - our sedan scraped the bottom. Should be mentioned in the listing.
Biju was the highlight of our trip - arranged a houseboat ride and cooked the best Kerala meals. Felt like family.
Outstanding hospitality. Biju anticipated everything. The bungalow is right on the backwaters.
Best caretaker we've ever had. Highly recommend.
Wonderful location and host. Mosquitoes were a problem in the evening - bring repellent.
Great host. The place smelled a bit damp, probably the humidity by the water.
The heating didn't work properly and Kasauli in December is freezing. We were cold all night despite raising it with the caretaker twice.
Room heater broken, very cold. Otherwise nice views.
Good views but the heating in two rooms was inadequate. Caretaker Deepak was helpful and lent us extra blankets.
Gorgeous sunsets from the deck. Deepak made excellent chai every morning. Heating could be better.
Loved it. Deepak took great care of us.
Worst experience. The villa was not cleaned before we arrived - dirty dishes in the sink and hair in the beds. Ganesh blamed the housekeeping vendor.
Arrived to an unclean property. Bedsheets were not changed. Very poor.
Cleanliness was a serious issue on arrival. The vineyard itself is beautiful though.
Lovely vineyard setting, great for a couples getaway. Wine tour next door was a highlight.
Nice property. A bit far from Nashik city, plan your travel.
Booked for a group but they turned away our extra guests at the gate citing occupancy policy. Felt blindsided - this wasn't clear at booking.
Second time staying here and Suresh remembers us every visit. Pool was clean this time - looks like they sorted it out.
Cleanliness needs serious attention. Second time I've faced this at a Spacez villa.
Great stay overall. Check-in over WhatsApp was smooth and quick.
The place is beautiful but the listing said 4 bedrooms and one was basically a store room with a mattress. Slightly oversold.
Loved the bonfire arrangement. Caretaker was attentive once he arrived.
Amazing.
Do not book. Misleading photos and no WiFi. Exactly the issues other reviews mentioned.
Great villa, Suresh excellent. Pool maintenance is the only recurring gripe I'd flag.
Late check-in again. Seems to be a pattern with this caretaker.
Biju is fantastic. Wish there were more restaurants nearby but that's the location, not the villa.
Beautiful sunsets over the vines. Perfect anniversary trip.
